# Coverage of 11-XX, number theory, in next

This is the coverage of math2 for the class and for its areas, at the levels of spec 18.1. The summary of all classes is in [next.md](../next.md).

Documents is the count of the documents of the source zbmath on 2026-10-26, and Counted is the records of the same source. C0 is Counted divided by Documents. Records is the records of all sources. C0 and C1 have a value only for a class with a count. Skeleton is the items of the skeleton of a class in topics/skeletons/, and Mapped is the items with a live node that has a source. C2 is Mapped divided by Skeleton, thus C2 has a value only for a class with a skeleton. C3 and C4 need the cores of spec 18.3, which are not written yet. A dash means that the level has no value.

| Code | Area | Records | Counted | Documents | C0 | C1 | Skeleton | Mapped | C2 | C3 | C4 | Nodes | E2 | E5 |
